description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Monitoring Extreme Wind Conditions along the Coastline during Landfalling Hurricanes is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jennifer Bridge, University of Florida (ufl.edu). During a hurricane, the instrumentation package will experience non-negligible deflection and vibration influencing the anemometers’ responses. The data collected in this project can be used to develop correction methods. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-m9wg-av69. Keywords: NHERI Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel; Anemometers; Structural Vibration; Non-negligible deflection and vibration; Sentinels. Published 2023-08-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
